{{Quote|Chop'aa has sent bounty hunters. Senator Bel Iblis has been captured by one of them, a mercenary named Kleef.|Lobot|<ref name="TFU databank" />}}
'''Kleef''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Otolla/Legends|Otolla]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] veteran of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]] who briefly served in [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks's]] security detail on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] before choosing to follow a criminal's path. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Kleef operated as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]. He eventually became the second-in-command of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Chop'aa Notimo]]'s [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] gang.

In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], Kleef was among Notimo's forces that [[Rescue of Garm Bel Iblis|attacked]] the [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[City/Legends|colony]] over the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. Following Notimo's orders, Kleef kidnapped Senator [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]] and delivered him to his boss. Kleef was confronted shortly afterward by [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] secret [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Galen Marek|Starkiller]], who sought to rescue the senator. Although Kleef prepared for the fight by activating two [[Heavy Tactical Fighting Unit]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]], he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Starkiller.

==Biography==
===Early life===
{{Quote|Meesa gonna pound you unto death.|Kleef|<ref name="TFU databank" />}}
[[File:Kleef.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Kleef]]
Kleef was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Otolla/Legends|Otolla]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] warrior native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="TFU databank" /> In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Kleef fought to liberate his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] from the invading forces of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], and he survived the conflict. Soon after the Federation was ousted from Naboo, Kleef left his homeworld for the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] as part of Gungan [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks's]] security detail.<ref name="TFU databank" />

However, having grown bored with his job and seeking both adventure and [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], Kleef left Binks's side and immersed himself in the shady businesses of the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Kleef found a good use for his fighting skills as he became a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], working for the highest bidder. Eventually, Kleef crossed paths with the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] criminal [[Crime lord/Legends|kingpin]] [[Chop'aa Notimo]], who hired the Gungan to train his [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] henchmen. Kleef went on to became Notimo's most trusted [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] and second-in-command.<ref name="TFU databank" />

===Bespin===
{{Quote|Weren't prepared for that, were you?|Starkiller, after killing Kleef|<ref name="TFU databank" />}}
In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Notimo's forces attacked the [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[City/Legends|colony]] over the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], engaging in [[Rescue of Garm Bel Iblis|battle]] against the [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guard]] led by the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Lobot/Legends|Lobot]],<ref name="TFU" /> the city's [[Computer/Legends|computer]] liaison officer.<ref name="TFU databank Lobot">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]'' {{C|[[Wikipedia:PlayStation Portable|PSP]], [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 2|PS2]] and [[Wikipedia:Wii|Wii]] versions' in-game databank}}, '''Lobot''' entry</ref> [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]] was present on Cloud City at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the battle, and he went to the loading bays in order to try to negotiate with Notimo to stop the violence. Notimo, however, decided to use the opportunity and kidnap the senator, dispatching his [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunters to do the job. Kleef managed to capture Bel Iblis and had him delivered to Notimo. Meanwhile, [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] secret [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Galen Marek|Starkiller]], arrived on Cloud City in search of the Senator, hoping to secure his support in the creation of an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|alliance]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Starkiller began to move through the colony, fighting Notimo's mercenaries. Having learned about Starkiller's presence, Kleef made sure to prepare for battle, as he always did. The Gungan retreated to one of Cloud City's tall buildings, backed by two [[Heavy Tactical Fighting Unit]] (H-TFU) [[Droid/Legends|droids]].<ref name="TFU" />

[[File:WerentPreparedForThat.png|thumb|right|250px|Starkiller chokes Kleef with the Force.]]
While Kleef made final adjustments to the droids, Starkiller entered the building and confronted the Gungan, demanding to know where the senator was. Kleef told him only that Notimo had Bel Iblis as hostage but did not reveal the exact location. As Starkiller activated his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], Kleef brought the droids on-line and brandished an edged blade, ready to fight. In a skirmish that followed, Starkiller destroyed the H-TFUs and engaged Kleef in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|close combat]], knocking the weapon out of the Gungan's [[Limb/Legends|hands]]. The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] apprentice then [[Telekinesis/Legends|gripped]] the Gungan with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], Force-choked him, and threw him out of a [[Window/Legends|window]] to his [[Death/Legends|death]], his body bouncing off Cloud City's heavy traffic. The aspiring Sith eventually located Bel Iblis and rescued the senator after killing Notimo.<ref name="TFU" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Meesa prepared. Yousa gonna die.|Kleef, to Starkiller|<ref name="TFU databank" />}}
Kleef was bored by the life of a security guard and willingly traded it for that of a mercenary and bounty hunter, seeking excitement and easy money. Kleef was loyal to Notimo, and the latter, in turn, trusted him.<ref name="TFU databank" /> Kleef was proud of his [[Species/Legends|species]] and was outraged by the mere possibility that Starkiller might have [[Speciesism|considered himself better]] than a Gungan.<ref name="TFU" />

Kleef also prided himself on the depth of his preparation, ensuring that he always had the equipment necessary for dealing with certain prey.<ref name="TFU databank" /> While fighting the Sith apprentice, Kleef behaved himself coolly, diminishing Starkiller's powers and mockingly pretending to be afraid of him. He was intent on killing Starkiller and enjoyed the thought of it. When the Sith apprentice asked him about Bel Iblis's whereabouts, Kleef responded with laughter. After Starkiller activated his lightsaber, however, Kleef became serious, stating that the situation was "not so funny" anymore.<ref name="TFU" /> Kleef had [[Color/Legends|orange]]-colored eyes and green skin.<ref name="TFU databank" /> At some point in his life, Kleef suffered an injury that cost him his entire right [[Eye/Legends|eyestalk]] and most of his right [[Haillu/Legends|haillu]], the Gungan [[Ear/Legends|ear]].<ref name="TFU" />

==Skills and abilities==
A fierce, relentless warrior and a master of many weapons, Kleef was greatly feared for his combat skills.<ref name="TFU" />

==Equipment==
During the battle against Starkiller, in addition to H-TFU droids, Kleef wielded a melee blade and complemented this by using [[Booma/Legends|boomas]],<ref name="TFU" /> the traditional Gungan weapon.<ref name="Databank gungan weaponry">{{DB|technology|gunganweaponry|Gungan weaponry}}</ref> Kleef wore long red straps that flowed from his wrist and white straps around his lower [[Limb/Legends|arms]]. He wore a black shoulder pad on his left side and a vest rather than a full shirt.<ref name="TFU" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kleef was created by [[Krome Studios]] for the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 2|PlayStation 2]], [[Wikipedia:PlayStation Portable|Playstation Portable]], and [[Wikipedia:Wii|Nintendo Wii]] versions of the [[2008]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed|''The Force Unleashed'']], wherein he was voiced by [[Kristoffer Tabori]], who also voiced Kleef's target for kidnapping, Garm Bel Iblis. Concept art labeled the character as "Mister Gung." In the game, Kleef can be unlocked as a playable character skin via the cheat code "KLEEF." When Kleef is selected, however, cutscenes are disabled.<ref name="TFU" />
